item1.summary: Client is class SignalWire: new SignalWire(credentialProvider: CredentialProvider | undefined, options?: SignalWireOptions). SAT supplied via CredentialProvider.authenticate(context?: {fingerprint?}) => Promise<SDKCredential {token?, authorizationState?, expiry_at? (ms epoch)}>; StaticCredentialProvider({token}) is the built-in fixed provider. Optional refresh?: () => Promise<SDKCredential> is called only when expiry_at is set and the SAT lacks 'sat:refresh' scope, scheduled CREDENTIAL_REFRESH_BUFFER_MS (5 s) before expiry, retried up to 5 times with backoff; on exhaustion TokenRefreshError('Credential refresh failed after max retries') is emitted on client.errors$ and the client disconnects. If expiry_at is set without refresh, warning code 'credential_no_refresh_handler' on warnings$. With 'sat:refresh' scope the SDK uses a DPoP (fingerprint = JWK thumbprint, key in IndexedDB sw-dpop) Client Bound SAT via /api/fabric/subscriber/devices/token and /devices/refresh; otherwise warning 'credential_refresh_fallback'. Registration: register() sends subscriber.online (auto unless skipRegister), unregister() sends subscriber.offline; isRegistered$, isConnected$, ready$.

item2.summary: incomingCalls$ lives on client.session (ClientSessionWrapper / SessionState), not on SignalWire: client.session.incomingCalls$: Observable<Call[]> (array snapshot of active inbound calls), plus incomingCalls, calls$, calls. Call properties: id (Verto callID, no separate callId), direction, to, toName, from, fromName, userVariables (+userVariables$), status$/status, localStream$/remoteStream$, rtcPeerConnection, self$/self, participants$, errors$, answered$ (WebRTCCall only), nodeId (WebRTCCall/CallManager only). Methods: answer(options?: MediaOptions): void, reject(): void, hangup(): Promise<void>, toggleHold, transfer, sendDigits. No headers or custom-data property. CallStatus = 'new'|'trying'|'ringing'|'connecting'|'connected'|'recovering'|'disconnecting'|'disconnected'|'failed'|'destroyed'; inbound starts 'ringing', outbound 'new'. Inbound fields come from verto.invite caller_id_name/number, callee_id_name/number, userVariables.

item3.summary: dial(destination: string | Address, options?: DialOptions): Promise<Call>. DialOptions extends MediaOptions {preferredVideoCodecs?, preferredAudioCodecs?, stereo?, nodeId?, userVariables?: Record<string, unknown>}; MediaOptions {audio? (default true), video? (default false), inputAudioDeviceConstraints?, inputVideoDeviceConstraints?, inputAudioStream?, inputVideoStream?, receiveAudio?, receiveVideo?, fallbackToReceiveOnly? (default true)}. No 'to' option; destination is first arg. Example: client.dial('/private/foo', { audio: true, video: false, userVariables: { k: 'v' } }). Destination query string (?channel=audio|video and other params) is merged; params also merged into userVariables. Invite carries userVariables {memberCallId, memberId, ...call.userVariables}. Bounded by 12 s signaling timeout after media settles.

item4.summary: Hold: call.toggleHold(): Promise<void> (verto.modify action hold/unhold; no public hold()/unhold() and no hold-state observable). Mute is on the participant: call.self.mute()/unmute()/toggleMute(), muteVideo()/unmuteVideo()/toggleMuteVideo(), toggleDeaf(); state audioMuted$/audioMuted. Hangup: call.hangup(). DTMF: call.sendDigits(dtmf: string). Transfer: call.transfer({ destination: string }). Answer/reject: call.answer(options?), call.reject().

item5.summary: Multiple SignalWire instances can be constructed (per-instance DependencyContainer, transport, session) but share global state: PreferencesContainer.instance singleton backs every client.preferences (including userVariables seeded into every new call), default SignalWireOptions, and global logger settings. Storage (localStorage/sessionStorage, default scope 'session'): per-subscriber keys sw:${userId}:as, sw:${userId}:pt, sw:${userId}:att; NOT per-subscriber: sw:cached_credential, sw:client_bound, sw:preferences, sw:device:audioinput/audiooutput/videoinput; IndexedDB sw-dpop/keys/dpop-keypair is a single DPoP key shared by all instances. With a provider, authenticate() is always called (cache only used without provider). For isolation use a per-instance storageImplementation, avoid persistSession/savePreferences, and pass userVariables per dial.

item6.summary: call.rtcPeerConnection: RTCPeerConnection | undefined exposes the main peer connection; use getStats() on it for codec reports. No SDK API returns the negotiated codec. Built-in stats monitor polls getStats() every 1000 ms and exposes networkMetrics$ (packets, jitter, RTT, availableOutgoingBitrate), networkIssues$, qualityScore$, qualityLevel$; client.exportDiagnostics(). Codec preferences: preferredAudioCodecs/preferredVideoCodecs/stereo per dial or in preferences; platformCapabilities.audioCodecs/videoCodecs.

item7.summary: Constants: connection timeout 10000 ms; reconnect backoff 100..3000 ms; reconnect calls timeout 300000 ms; server ping timeout 15000 ms (server pings every 10 s), probe 10000 ms; call signaling timeout 12000 ms; aux leg 15000 ms; ICE candidate 600 ms, gathering 6000 ms; device token TTL 900 s, refresh buffer 30000 ms, 3 retries base 1000 ms; developer credential refresh buffer 5000 ms, 5 retries base 1000 ms max 30000 ms; expiry skew 30000 ms; activation timeout 30000 ms; RPC timeout 5 s; max recovery attempts 3; reinvite max 3. No max-device count and no client-side ring timeout found.

item8.summary: dist/browser.umd.js assigns global.SignalWire = {} (globalThis) as a namespace; the client class is window.SignalWire.SignalWire, with window.SignalWire.StaticCredentialProvider, TokenRefreshError, version '4.0.0-rc.4', ready=true. Dependencies are bundled. Fires window event 'signalwire:js:ready' {detail:{version}} on load. Playwright: page.addScriptTag({path: '.../dist/browser.umd.js'}) then new window.SignalWire.SignalWire(new window.SignalWire.StaticCredentialProvider({token}))
